name: Deathstroke
summary: A one-eyed mercenary who never lets a contract go. Slade Wilson, boosted by an army experiment, is DC's top assassin and a longtime enemy of the Teen Titans.
origin: Deathstroke is the mercenary who made a whole team of teenagers his life's work, and that grudge made him a classic. Marv Wolfman and George Pérez introduced him in The New Teen Titans #2 in 1980 as Deathstroke the Terminator, picking up a contract on the Titans that his son had died trying to fulfil. Slade Wilson was a soldier until an army experiment boosted his body and his mind, giving him super strength and speed, razor reflexes and senses, faster healing and slowed aging. He lost an eye later on, but he remains one of the deadliest assassins in DC, lethal with a sword, a rifle or his bare hands.
powers: Expert with swords, guns and his fists

storyline.title: The Terminator
storyline.beat: Slade Wilson, a mercenary known as Deathstroke the Terminator, debuts in The New Teen Titans #2. He takes over a contract on the Titans after his son dies trying to carry it out.

storyline.title: The inside job
storyline.beat: Deathstroke plants the young Terra inside the Titans as a spy, leading to one of the team's most famous stories.

storyline.title: Antihero run
storyline.beat: Deathstroke gets his own long-running series as a mercenary with his own code, rather than a straight villain.

storyline.title: Family man from hell
storyline.beat: Christopher Priest's acclaimed run digs into Slade's damaged relationships with his children and his own cruelty.

gossip.text: Deathstroke started out as a Batman villain.
gossip.truth: He was created as a Teen Titans villain in 1980 and only later became a regular Batman foe.

gossip.text: Deadpool's real name, Wade Wilson, was a deliberate nod by writer Fabian Nicieza to Slade Wilson.
He lost his right eye when his wife Adeline shot him, after their son was hurt because of Slade's work.
An army experiment boosted his body and his mind, making him a master tactician.
Manu Bennett played him on Arrow, and Joe Manganiello played him in Justice League (2017).

quiz.q: Which team did Deathstroke first fight?
Who did Deathstroke plant inside the Titans as a spy?

theme.tagline: One eye, two swords, always on the clock.

timeline.title: The Terminator
timeline.note: New Teen Titans #2 introduces Slade Wilson, a one-eyed mercenary who takes over a contract on the Titans.

timeline.title: The Judas Contract
timeline.note: Slade plants the traitor Terra inside the Titans and nearly destroys the team.

timeline.title: Antihero star
timeline.note: Deathstroke the Terminator #1 gives Slade his own book, and he becomes a cult antihero.

timeline.title: Slade on TV
timeline.note: The Teen Titans cartoon makes him the masked chessmaster Slade, voiced by Ron Perlman.

timeline.title: Arrow
timeline.note: Manu Bennett plays Slade on Arrow, turning from island ally to sworn enemy.

timeline.title: Priest's run
timeline.note: Christopher Priest relaunches Deathstroke in a run often named among the character's best.
